title: We have gone from Sports Store Throwing Up all over the driveway to garage almost done
summary: In the first photo you see sports stuff everywhere. The second photo it is dark, mNy hours later, and scraps of sports deciduous litter the image. The third photo shows the garage almost clean. Our annual Halloween party shouldn't be called All Hallow's Eve but a Thanksgiving to the Gods for surviving another annual clean up.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
